ideas.title: Follow the Money: Where Did $250M in Feeding Our Future Funds Actually Go?
ideas.summary: Aimee Bock was ordered to forfeit $5.2M, but the scheme allegedly stole $250M+. Where's the rest? Track property records, shell companies, and overseas transfers.
questions: What properties were purchased by FOF defendants during the fraud period?
Are there connections between FOF sites and other state programs?
Which shell companies were used to move money?

ideas.title: Ghost Providers: How Many Closed Daycares Are Still Getting Paid?
ideas.summary: Nick Shirley's viral video showed Mako Childcare closed for years but still in the payment system. How widespread is this? FOIA the full provider list and cross-reference with business closures.
questions: How many licensed daycare providers have closed but remain in payment systems?
What's the total amount paid to closed facilities?
Why didn't DCYF catch this during regular audits?
sources: Google Maps/Street View for site verification

ideas.title: Collateral Damage: Legitimate Providers Caught in Fraud Fallout
ideas.summary: Somali-owned daycares report vandalism and threats after viral video. Legitimate providers face funding freeze. Who suffers when fraud investigations go public?
questions: How many legitimate providers are affected by the funding freeze?
What's the timeline for audits and fund restoration?
Are hate incidents being tracked and prosecuted?
dataNeeded: Number of providers affected by freeze

ideas.title: Pattern Recognition: Do Other State Programs Have the Same Vulnerabilities?
ideas.summary: FOF exploited pandemic-era loosened controls. Housing Stabilization Services had similar issues ($302M). What other programs had rapid expansion with minimal oversight?
questions: Which Minnesota programs saw 10x+ growth during pandemic?
What oversight mechanisms were waived or reduced?
Are there providers operating across multiple vulnerable programs?
